name: Copper shelf
description: A row of book spines drawn as Kefrens copper bars: each spine shaded in hard bands, dark at the edges and bright in the centre, in red-gold, blue and violet ramps, with the last book leaning in whole-pixel steps.
choices: Vertical copper bars with stepped ramps, overlapping as later bars do, become spines with a few dark bands
No big scroller and no black backdrop: just the shelf
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
